title: Contact cleaner: messy spreadsheet to CRM import
one_line: Cleans a messy contact spreadsheet into a file a CRM will accept, and reports every change.
problem: A business has a contact spreadsheet built up over years, with names in capitals, phone numbers in ten formats and the same people listed several times. Its CRM import rejects the file or fills the CRM with junk.
what_it_does: Guesses which column is which and lets a mapping file correct it
Fixes names, splits full names, and formats emails, UK phone numbers, dates and postcodes
Merges exact duplicates and flags likely ones for a person to decide
Sets aside rows with no way to contact anyone, with the reason
Writes a one-page report counting every change, with examples
Traces every output row back to its original row number
